line.en: a jazz show under the planetarium dome at 11:00, about 60 minutes. book on the planetarium site; tickets start around 11 euro.
line.de: eine jazz-show unter der planetariumskuppel um 11:00, rund 60 minuten. tickets über die seite des planetariums; ab etwa 11 euro.
line.tr: planetaryum kubbesinin altında saat 11:00'de bir caz gösterisi, yaklaşık 60 dakika. biletleri planetaryum sitesinden al; fiyat yaklaşık 11 euro'dan başlıyor.

sparks.why: Cosmic Jazz at the Planetarium Hamburg, sun 22.11 11:00, about 60 min (planetarium-hamburg.de Spielplan, hamburg-tourism.de, ticketonline.de). Prices differ by source, so 'around 11 euro' is approximate.
